source_evidence: PaintCanvas677–699 uses cursor.offset then stroke for single-finger cursor drawing; it does not pan viewport. Amharic explicitly targets view; Kurdish bigerîne is ambiguous generic movement, classified cursor-target clarification rather than explicit viewport error. Three live instructions and guide clause changed; two-finger navigation preserved.

ImageResizeDialog42 uses current.workingBytes for RAM and current.maxPixels(residentPixels)/1e6 for MP. Exclusion explicitly applies only to MP estimate; additional decoder memory rather than ambiguous additional cost.
ImageAssembly205–217 checks placement of item itself, not only an attachment target; generic image wording restored, separate missing-anchor error unchanged.

Amharic Unplace prose says others remain at their places; ImageAssembly95–128 can reflow. Editor9/assembly6 now say remain in workspace. Exact-position fixed-coordinate clauses unchanged. Kurdish bicihkirî dimînin already states placed state; no change.

Kurdish BG/FG opaque abbreviations in guide and two live hints replaced with descriptive foreground/background, consistent with actual ui_bg Paşplan/ui_fg Pêşplan and ui_background_colour Rengê paşplanê. Control vocabulary clarification, no behavior change.

Kurdish ICO description uses rectangle/quadrilateral çargoşe while own ui_square=Kare and IcoCodec86 creates edge×edge square,102 writes same dimensions. Narrow square-term correction preserves transparency, centering, proportions, PNG compression and size range.
